kind: Parent reconciliation of raw verification artifacts; supersedes unsupported verifier prose, not the raw records.

runs.failure: Archived download completed its CLI steps but the harness found no NEW directory entry; stale-client and empty download cases were then blocked.
Wait-for-text command timed out; the subsequent snapshot was about:blank and a navigation selector was missing.
runs.cause: UNKNOWN. The filename-discovery code runs AFTER this wait, so its failure does not establish why this earlier command timed out.

executionAccounting.observed: Two run intervals overlap by several minutes. They are not sequential before/after tests.
executionAccounting.unresolved: The verifier calls the first directory prior work, but has not established its initiating owner/tool call. Neither a single-run claim nor an attribution of both launches to one owner is established here.
executionAccounting.policy: Do not combine counts or describe the pair as a clean single invocation.

sourceBinding.actualScope: Nine src files, three public files and the E2E harness.
sourceBinding.harnessProducedChecks: Both run reports bind 12 src/public files and finish with changedSources=[].
sourceBinding.missing: README and test-source pre/post pins were not retained; an independent final harness hash was not retained.
sourceBinding.correction: The verifier's statements of 12 total captured files and no possible source-change detection are both too broad. The actual partial binding above is what is supported.

causalEvidence.established: Two blob downloads with distinct response bytes save at the same completed filename. The page remains live and the success notice exists. New-name-only discovery therefore misses valid repeated downloads.
causalEvidence.notEstablished: This does not prove the production archived page emitted a notice during the timed-out run, nor identify that timeout's cause.
causalEvidence.fix: Move each completed actual browser file to its unique retained evidence path so a later same-name download must create a fresh inbox file. Production app code is unchanged.
causalEvidence.verification: The subsequent serial replay verified three saved CSV comparisons, but failed overall at the empty-export notice wait. The final file-first replay below also failed. No clean all-flow pass.

nativeResult.scope: Backend native suite, not frontend or qualified changed-line coverage.

unsupportedVerifierClaims: The second timeout was caused by filename overwriting or file discovery starving the wait.
The first run's downloads directory was empty: its failure only says there were no new entries.
All archived exports or production notifications were proved by the independent minimal control.
Four of five attempted downloads succeeded: each retained full-run report records two completed comparisons.
A claim of corrected interpretation automatically validates the verifier's subsequent summary.

serialReplay.failure: Command211 wait-for-text exited124 after25 seconds of silence. Commands212-218 did execute, including empty-page snapshots and successful CLI close.
serialReplay.cause: UNKNOWN. No assertion that an empty-project production defect or the previous filename bug caused this timeout.
serialReplay.correctionsToVerifierProse: The raw records contain218 commands, not217, and the inner deadline was25 seconds, not120. A failed flow is not a100% pass rate.
serialReplay.nextObservationPath: The repeated wait-for-text primitive is blocked after two idle kills. The harness now waits for the actual completed file first, with the unchanged12-second file bound, then asserts the exact notice text through ordinary DOM inspection. Both file and notice assertions remain required.
serialReplay.nextVerification: Completed as the failed fileFirstReplay below, not a retry of the blocked wait command. No further browser trials authorized.

fileFirstReplay.failure: Command136 ordinary DOM eval hit25s idle during stale-client notice assertion, after the physical file was retained. Command138 showed about:blank; command139 failed its editor selector. Command144 closed the owned browser successfully.
fileFirstReplay.sourceBinding: Harness report binds12 app src/public files and changedSources=[]. Separate pre/post manifests contain both valid hashes and invented/missing paths with null hashes; null equality is not evidence. README was again checked at the wrong path and is unbound.
fileFirstReplay.cause: UNKNOWN. Failure is not limited to the wait-for-text primitive. No app production patch is justified by this observation.
fileFirstReplay.disposition: Stop browser trials after these bounded alternatives. Preserve actual working download scenarios and every failed overall result; do not claim a completed browser suite.

overall: Incomplete verification; no full browser pass, final independent approval, qualified metrics or G6 closure.
